name: Gas Pipeline Branch and GRS Mariysky NPZ, with Inter-settlement Line to Kilemary (Mari El / Kirov)

values.PipelineName: Gas Pipeline Branch and GRS Mariysky NPZ, with Inter-settlement Line to Kilemary
values.StartLocation: GRS Mariysky NPZ (Orshanka district, Mari El)

monitor_reason: length: no sourced length on any verified page (Kommersant, Neftegaz.ru, Svoboda/Idel.Realii, regional gov pages); the >56 km snippet is unciteable. Sponsor (Gazprom) and endpoints are fine; the concrete step is only a programme addendum signed 2022-10-12, and no tender/permit found. Cannot confirm >=25 km.
researcher_notes: Not an existing GEM row: roster scan (285 gas rows) has no Mari El/Kirov/Kilemary/Mariysky entry. Confirmed: on 2022-10-12 (Russian Energy Week) Gazprom and Mari El signed an addendum to the 2021-2025 gasification programme: a gas pipeline branch with new GRS 'Mariysky NPZ' and a line from it to Kilemary urban settlement, in part through Kirov Oblast (Sanchursk district); serves ~2.7k households and six boilers in Kilemary and Yurino districts (sibling Yurino line from GRS Voskresenskoye, Nizhny Novgorod, also has no length). Svoboda/Idel.Realii says the Kilemary supply runs from Orshansky district via Kirov Oblast. No length stated anywhere verifiable; likely a trunk branch plus inter-settlement distribution line (possibly a distribution-class asset). Monitor for: published length, PSD/permit/tender, or construction start (planned from 2025). Route: none published; no route. If length later confirmed >=25 km, stage as proposed/construction, Owner Gazprom PJSC, RouteType Unavailable / no route. Tier medium.
